Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Hobo Santa Fuzz $ 139.00 Sold out The Hobo Santa started off as a fun one off for a friend who made the raddest Santa image for a band flier. But it was too cool not share! The circuit is a muff style fuzz using old Russian germanium transistors. Stink, Drunk and Hostility knobs control the tone, fuzz and volume. It's kinda gritty, kinda smooth and ridiculously loud. Pretty much everything you'd want in a real life hobo Santa! These are only available in very limited holiday season runs! SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "It was an unexpected surprise picking up this Hobo Santa fuzz tonight. I’d had my eye one already and there it was! I ran it through a little practice amp when I got home and it screams! Excellent work!" -Brett N.
